name: 🌱 Magic Garden Tycoon
description: Buy seeds, grow magical plants and sell your harvest to become the richest gardener! Plants keep growing while you are offline. Catch Rain, Thunderstorms and Golden Hours for Wet, Shocked, Golden and Rainbow fruits worth up to 50x. Expand your garden, upgrade sprinklers, rebirth for huge multipliers and grow the Mythic Crystal Lotus! Play with friends for +10% each.
